places.name: Lake Louise
places.note: A glacial lake in Banff National Park.

places.name: Grand-Sault waterfall
places.note: A waterfall called Grand-Sault on the lower Saint Lawrence or the Gaspé coast; which one is not yet confirmed.

places.name: Le Buton lookout, Le Massif de Charlevoix
places.note: Signature lookout on a man-made mound at the summit; wide view over the St. Lawrence and the mountains. Easy 2 km loop, 45 min, from the summit (resort and trail sites). Check the gondola and mountain access run on your dates; a 2026 notice mentioned a suspension during a strike…

places.name: Canyon Sainte-Anne
places.note: 74 m waterfall with suspension bridges across the gorge (from memory, unverified). About 40 min east of Quebec City; combine with Montmorency Falls and Ile d'Orleans. Check opening dates, fees and kids' rules.

places.name: La Crête trail, Mont-Sainte-Anne
places.note: One of seven foot trails up Mont-Sainte-Anne to a summit tower with a 360-degree view; 2.9 km, about 2 hours.

places.name: Montmorency Falls
places.note: An 83 m waterfall, 30 m higher than Niagara, 15 minutes from Old Québec.

places.name: Mont Saddle and Montagne de Marbre loop
places.note: A demanding 17.8 km loop over two border summits, Marble Mountain and Mont Saddle, about 9 hours.

places.name: Sentier des Cimes, Parc national du Mont-Mégantic
places.note: Mountain trail through forest with mountain scenery. The park is a dark-sky reserve (from memory).

places.name: Cap-Bon-Ami
places.note: A sea-cliff cape in Forillon National Park and the start of the Mont-Saint-Alban climb.

places.name: Cap-Gaspé
places.note: The tip of the Gaspé Peninsula: a lighthouse on a 95 m cliff and Land's End, reached on foot in Forillon.

places.name: Mont Saint-Alban
places.note: A 285 m summit with an observation tower and sea views, 1.5 to 2 hours round trip from Cap-Bon-Ami.

places.name: Sentier La Chute
places.note: A short steep forest loop to a 17 m waterfall, with a red chair at its foot, in Forillon.

places.name: La Martre Lighthouse
places.note: A red octagonal lighthouse of 1906 on the Saint Lawrence, designated a heritage lighthouse in 2026.

places.name: Mont-Saint-Pierre
places.note: A Gaspé coast village under a 430 m mountain: free-flight launch, summit observatory, shuttle and year-round trails.

places.name: Lac aux Américains
places.note: A lake under Mont Xalibu in Parc national de la Gaspésie, reached on foot from a 40-place car park.

places.name: Mont Xalibu
places.note: A 1,120 m summit with tundra panoramas and woodland caribou habitat, open 1 July to 30 September.

places.name: L'Éperon
places.note: Forest hike with a steep initial climb and several viewpoints over the Jacques-Cartier Valley. Near Quebec City. The pin is approximate, at the park's discovery-centre area.

places.name: Pic Champlain
places.note: The highest summit of the south-shore estuary region, via a 7.7 km return trail in Parc national du Bic.

places.name: Bonaventure Island
places.note: An island park with a northern gannet colony of about 110,000 birds, reached by boat from Percé.

places.name: Percé Rock
places.note: An 88 m rock with a natural arch off Percé, the best-known landmark of the Gaspé Peninsula.

places.name: Canyon des Portes de l'Enfer
places.note: A 5 km river canyon with walls up to 90 m, the Grand Sault falls and Québec's highest suspension footbridge.

places.name: Mont du Dôme
places.note: A summit trail with three summits and views toward the Saint Lawrence, in the Zec des Martres.

places.name: QQ Canyon Racer mountain coaster, Gulong Gorge
places.note: Licensed QQ Speed (Chinese kart game) themed mountain coaster: a 3.68 km descent through the mountain and forest of Gulong Gorge (古龙峡), Qingxin District, Qingyuan, with 28 turns and 9 hairpins. From a French Instagram post; figures unverified. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (the…

places.name: Provence
places.note: Peak lavender mid June to mid July. Gordes, Roussillon, Senanque Abbey. 4-5 days.

places.name: Paris
places.note: Book the Eiffel Tower and Louvre online. Marais, Montmartre, Latin Quarter. 4-5 days.

places.name: Gurudongmar Lake
places.note: Loose line in Location.md, no details. High-altitude lake in North Sikkim; permits and altitude (about 5,400 m) to check (from memory).

places.name: Sorrento and the Amalfi Coast
places.note: Base in Sorrento for day trips; Positano, Ravello, limoncello; boat tour along the coast. 3-4 days.

places.name: Capri
places.note: Day trip from Sorrento or Naples; the Blue Grotto closes in waves.

places.name: Rome
places.note: Colosseum, Vatican (advance booking), Trevi. 4-5 days.

places.name: Lake Como
places.note: Stay in Bellagio or Varenna; the ferry between towns is scenic. 2-3 days.

places.name: Milan
places.note: Duomo, Last Supper (book months ahead), fashion district. Day trip from Lake Como.

places.name: Trento
places.note: Gateway to the Dolomites; wine region, historic centre. 1-2 days.

places.name: Florence
places.note: Uffizi, Duomo, David (book Uffizi and Accademia ahead); day trip to the Tuscan countryside. 3-4 days.

places.name: Dolomites
places.note: Tre Cime di Lavaredo is the icon.

places.name: Venice
places.note: Stay on the main island, not Mestre; early morning walks. 2-3 days.

places.name: Verona
places.note: Roman arena, Juliet balcony, wine region. Combine with Venice. 1-2 days.

places.name: Kennecott River rafting (Wrangell-St. Elias)
places.note: World-class rafting, pristine wilderness. Requires planning well in advance; consider a guided expedition. 7+ days.

places.name: Page
places.note: Stop 1 of the AZ-UT-CO-WY road trip post. Base for Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend.

places.name: Havasupai (Havasu Falls)
places.note: Red rock canyon walls, lush waterfalls and clear pools at the bottom of the Grand Canyon. From memory (unverified): permits required, sell out fast, open months ahead; the hike in to the village and campground is long, so check what is realistic with children. Check the official…

places.name: Monument Valley
places.note: Stop 10 of the road trip post. Tribal park, fee and hours to check.

places.name: Durango
places.note: Stop 11 of the road trip post. Durango and Silverton narrow-gauge railroad.

places.name: Manitou Incline
places.note: Steep stair climb on an old railway bed with views over Colorado Springs (figures from memory, unverified). Very strenuous, starts about 6,500 ft; check age limits for children. A reservation was required in recent years; check current rules and fee. Usual way down is the Barr T…

places.name: Million Dollar Highway
places.note: Stop 12 of the road trip post. US 550 between Silverton and Ouray; exposed drops, no guardrails in places (from memory).

places.name: Ouray
places.note: Stop 13 of the road trip post.

places.name: Breckenridge
places.note: Stop 14 of the road trip post.

places.name: Cape Cod
places.note: Beaches, whale watching, seafood, lighthouses. Book whale watching in advance. 3-4 days.

places.name: White Mountain National Forest
places.note: Kancamagus Highway is a must-drive; mountain hikes, fall colours.

places.name: Watkins Glen State Park
places.note: Gorge trail with stone steps, tunnels and many waterfalls (from memory, unverified). Gorge trail is seasonal, roughly mid May to late Oct. Check open trails and parking fee on NY State Parks. Pairs with the Vermont and New Hampshire fall trips.

places.name: Finger Lakes
places.note: Wineries, gorges, waterfalls, scenic lakes. 3-4 days. Watkins Glen State Park is the must.

places.name: Arches National Park
places.note: Stop 8 of the road trip post; already in the Utah parks plan.

places.name: Stansbury Island
places.note: Stop 17 of the road trip post. Great Salt Lake; access by causeway (from memory).

places.name: Bentonite Hills
places.note: Stop 5 of the road trip post. Remote, unpaved access; check road conditions.

places.name: Factory Butte
places.note: Stop 6 of the road trip post. Remote; check road conditions.

places.name: Long Dong Silver Spire
places.note: Stop 7 of the road trip post. Sandstone spire near Hanksville; exact location to confirm.

places.name: Kanarra Falls
places.note: Stop 3 of the road trip post. Permit-limited slot canyon walk (from memory, unverified).

places.name: Bryce Canyon National Park
places.note: Stop 4 of the road trip post; already in the Utah parks plan.

places.name: Canyonlands National Park
places.note: Stop 9 of the road trip post; already in the Utah parks plan.

places.name: Zion National Park
places.note: Stop 2 of the road trip post; already in the Utah parks plan.

places.name: Stowe
places.note: Peak fall foliage, charming villages, covered bridges. Best late Sep to mid Oct; combine with the White Mountains.

places.name: Lake Wenatchee
places.note: Washington State road trip, add-on if there is time. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Leavenworth
places.note: Washington State road trip, add-on if there is time. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Columbia River Gorge
places.area_name: Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area
places.note: Washington State road trip, add-on if there is time (the post says the Washington side). Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Olympic Peninsula
places.note: Washington State road trip stop 5. Visit Forks, Neah Bay, Lake Crescent. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest
places.note: Washington State road trip stop 3 (the post says Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest). Franklin Falls (very short hike), Barclay Lake (easy hike), visit Skykomish and Index. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Lake Chelan
places.note: Washington State road trip, add-on if there is time (the post says Lake Chelan / Stehekin; Stehekin is at the head of the lake). Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Mount Baker Wilderness
places.note: Washington State road trip stop 1. Artist Point (drive-up viewpoint), Huntoon Point (short hike), Chain Lakes Loop (moderate day hike). Placeholder from a saved post; stops and hike labels as posted, unverified.

places.name: Mount St. Helens
places.area_name: Mount St. Helens National Volcanic Monument
places.note: Washington State road trip, add-on if there is time. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Mount Rainier National Park
places.note: Washington State road trip stop 4: hike Fremont Lookout tower for sunrise, swim in the Ohanapecosh river, visit Sunrise and Paradise. From a saved post, unverified.

places.name: North Cascades National Park
places.note: Washington State road trip stop 2. Rent a canoe on Ross Lake; hike the Maple Pass loop for sunset (labelled a challenging hike in the post); Diablo Lake vista point. Placeholder from a saved post, unverified.

places.name: Yellowstone National Park
places.note: Stop 16 of the road trip post. Also covered in usa-southwest-rockies research (yellowstone-supplement).

places.name: Grand Teton National Park
places.note: Stop 15 of the road trip post. Also covered in usa-southwest-rockies research (family-teton).

places.name: Hanoi
places.note: Old Quarter, Train Street (check current access rules), Hoan Kiem Lake, Temple of Literature, water puppet show. Stays named in the post: Hanoi Diamond King Hotel, Queen Cafe Hotel & Pub. Post costs in INR (Delhi traveller): 1,800-3,000 a night; 5,000-8,000 for 2 days.

places.name: Sapa
places.note: Four-day post: Day 1 town and Mong Village (Stone Church, Ban Mong alpine coaster, Rainbow Slide, Moana Cafe, night market); Day 2 Fansipan cable car and the mountain train at La Do Cafe; Day 3 Muong Hoa Valley trek, Lao Chai, Ta Van, Giang Ta Chai, homestay; Day 4 O Quy Ho Pass…

places.name: Ha Long Bay
places.note: Overnight cruise among the limestone islands; kayaking and caves usually included. Post (INR): 10,000-20,000 for 2 days; cruises named Amanda Pearl 14,000-16,000, Uni Charm about 25,000 a night, La Regina Classic about 14,000, Genesis Regal and Venus 20,000-22,000; budget altern…
